Hero.title: Jaegerpeak en
Hero.htext: Personal training, coaching and athletic training in the Rhine Valley. Personal, with a plan and with progress we measure.
Hero.atext1: My name is Ramon Jäger – sport has been a solid part of my life since childhood. Today I work as a certified fitness coach (SAFS) and specialist in athletic performance.
Hero.atext2: I help people become stronger, more resilient, and more confident – whether pro athletes, hobby athletes or beginners. Always with the goal: maximum performance without neglecting health.
Hero.afield2: Individual or team – flexible and adaptable
Hero.afield4: Training with real potential for progress
Hero.stext: Find the service that best fits your everyday life and goals.
Hero.f1_q: Do I need prior knowledge or already be fit?
Hero.f1_a: You don’t need any prior knowledge. All training is individually adapted to your current level – whether you are starting out, coming back, or aiming to improve your performance.
Hero.f2_q: What if I don’t master the technique?
Hero.f2_a: No problem. I’ll teach you the technique step by step and place great importance on clean execution. This way we maximize your training and prevent injuries.
Hero.f3_q: Is there a trial session? How does it work?
Hero.f3_a: Yes. In the trial session, I analyze your movement patterns, mobility, and current condition. We start with a conversation, followed by a check of your basic movements, then we define the next steps.
Hero.f4_q: How much does the training cost?
Hero.f4_a: You can find all prices on the Services page. For example: personal training CHF 120.– per hour (as a pair CHF 80.– per person), 6-month coaching online CHF 149.– or with personal training CHF 219.– per month, training planning from CHF 59.– and classes from CHF 20.– per person. The initial consultation is free of charge. All prices excl. VAT.
Hero.f5_a: That depends on your goal: at Kraftwerk Fitness in Heerbrugg, outdoors (for example on the 400m track in Balgach or on the tennis court at TC Widnau) or at your home. Online coaching works from anywhere.
Hero.f6_q: How often do I need to train to see changes?
Hero.f6_a: That depends on your goal and starting point. As a rule, I recommend at least 2 sessions per week to achieve noticeable progress. Consistency is the most important success factor.
Hero.f7_q: Do you also train women? How old do I need to be?
Hero.f7_a: Of course. I train both women and men, depending on the goal – whether muscle building, toning, or functional training for pain prevention. I don’t set strict age limits. Generally, my target group is between 12 and 60 years old. In the free consultation, we will clarify together whether cooperation makes sense.
Hero.f8_a: In coaching, you can make up a missed session within the same month. In case of injury or illness with a doctor’s certificate, coaching can be paused for up to 1 month.
Hero.f9_q: Can I also be coached online?
Hero.f9_a: Yes. Coaching is also available online for CHF 149.– per month: a training plan for the gym or at home, a weekly check-in with my feedback (including on your technique videos) and a 30-minute video call per month. Ideal if you live further away or want to stay flexible.
Hero.f10_q: How does working together look like?
Hero.f10_a: After the initial consultation, we create your training plan and start with the coaching – including 1:1 support, training plan, nutrition tips, and regular reflection.
Hero.ctext: Contact me today for a free initial consultation!

About.hsubtitle: Expert in athletics, performance & sustainable fitness
About.htext: My name is Ramon Jäger, born in 2000. Sport has been a solid part of my life since childhood, from the football pitch to the tennis court to strength training. Today I pass on what I have learned along the way.
About.hbutton: Let’s take the first step together!
About.pssubtitle1: I believe in training that strengthens the body
About.pspoint1_text1: I don’t just want to offer training, but make real change possible. More strength. Maximum performance. A better body feeling.
About.pspoint1_text2: My goal is to reconnect people with their bodies: more capable, resilient, and confident. Whether pro athlete, hobby athlete, or someone training preventively – I guide you individually and lead you purposefully to your goal.
About.pspoint2_text1: Health comes first. Because what is the point of the greatest performance if it comes at the cost of your body? That’s why I work according to the Healthy Performance concept. My approach always begins with a solid foundation: stability, mobility, functional movements, clean technique, and progressive load.
About.pspoint2_text2: Injury prevention is not a side goal for me, but the prerequisite for real progress. Whether in sport or everyday life – those who train smart remain capable, resilient, and mobile. I help people achieve just that: build strength and performance without overloading the body. The goal is a body that functions long-term, feels good, and carries you even under stress.

items.title: Athletic Performance Training
items.subtitle: Faster, stronger, more resilient in your sport.
items.description: You want to take the next step in your sport. I train you 1:1, tailored to your sport, your club training and your competitions. That makes you faster, stronger and more resilient, with fewer injuries. We train at Kraftwerk Fitness Heerbrugg, outdoors or at your home.

highlight.title: Specialty: tennis
highlight.text: Tennis is my specialty. We train what counts on court: footwork, quick changes of direction, trunk rotation, a strong shoulder and the endurance for long matches. I plan around your tennis training and tournaments and coordinate with your tennis coach if needed.

rows: from CHF 120.– per hour, by arrangement

tables.title: Support (optional, cancellable monthly)
rows: I am available for you, coordinate with your club coach and plan around training and competitions.
Everything in Basic. On top, I plan your mobility and endurance and give you nutrition tips.

notes: You get a strength training plan with Training planning A.

items.title: Personal Training
items.subtitle: Train regularly, with me by your side.
items.description: You want to get fit again, get stronger or simply train regularly. I plan every session around your goal, correct your technique and progress you step by step. We train at Kraftwerk Fitness Heerbrugg, outdoors or at your home. As a pair, for example with your partner or a friend, you train for less.

points.title: Get fit again
points.text: Bending, lifting, carrying and climbing stairs feel safe and strong again, even after a long break.

points.title: Get stronger
points.text: You build strength and muscle in a targeted way.

points.title: Learn technique
points.text: You learn the exercises properly and then train safely on your own.

items.title: Health training for Parkinson’s
items.subtitle: Mobile and safe in everyday life.
items.description: In 1:1 training we work on mobility, balance and strength. That keeps you safe in everyday life and helps you improve where possible. The training complements your medical and therapeutic treatment, and I coordinate with your doctor or physiotherapist if needed.

points.text: Twice a week for 45 minutes, at least once of which at the gym.
If needed, I come to your home, with exercises you can also do on your own.
On request, you get a simple home programme for the days in between.

items.title: Coaching · 6 months
items.subtitle: Reach your goal in 6 months, guided week by week.
items.description: You want to lose weight, get toned or get stronger. You train on your own, I give you the plan, check your progress every week and train with you regularly.

points.title: Start
points.text: You fill in a short questionnaire beforehand. Then we talk for 60 minutes, take measurements and check your technique, on site or via video.

points.title: Every week
points.text: You briefly report on activity, nutrition, sleep and weight. I give you feedback, including on your technique videos. For nutrition, you get simple weekly goals.

points.title: Every month
points.text: We measure circumferences, photos and strength values, online you measure yourself following my instructions. Then I adjust your nutrition goals. After 6 months, you see in black and white what has changed.

items.title: Performance Training
items.subtitle: Ready for your competition day.
items.description: You are preparing for a Hyrox, a race or a fitness competition, or you have a clear performance goal. I plan strength, endurance and technique so that you are ready on competition day. We train at Kraftwerk Fitness Heerbrugg, outdoors or at your home.

items.title: Training planning
items.subtitle: A plan that fits. Then you train on your own.
items.description: You like training on your own, but want a plan that really fits you and the confidence that you are training correctly. You choose what you need. Each building block is one appointment on site, no subscription.

points.title: A · Training plan
points.text: Your personal plan, matched to your goal, experience and time.

points.title: B · Technique check
points.text: I watch your exercises at the gym and correct them.

points.title: C · Nutrition
points.text: Simple tips you can put into practice in everyday life.

notes: Other combinations (e.g. A + C) are possible. I am happy to tell you the price in the initial consultation.

items.title: Classes
items.subtitle: Train outdoors, together.
items.description: A fixed programme in the open air, for every fitness level and with max. 8 people. You sign up via the WhatsApp group. The more people join, the cheaper it gets for everyone, so bring someone along.
